Past subjunctive combines subjunctive avoir/être with a past participle to mark prior completion: je suis content qu'elle soit venue means I am glad she came. Certain constructions, such as bien que (although), require subjunctive even for a factual event, so meaning alone is not a complete rule.

explanation: Conditional past combines conditional avoir or être with a past participle: j'aurais accepté means I would have accepted; elle serait venue means she would have come. It can express an unreal past result, regret, reproach or cautiously reported information, depending on context. For a counterfactual past condition, use si plus plus-que-parfait, then conditional past: si j'avais su, je serais venu means if I had known, I would have come (masculine). Do not use conditional directly after si in this condition pattern. Distinguish regret from an accusation through tone and context.

outcome: I can select connectors that express addition, contrast or consequence accurately.
explanation: Discourse connectors show the relationship between ideas rather than decorating a paragraph. En outre adds support; toutefois and néanmoins introduce a limitation; en revanche contrasts a different aspect; par conséquent marks an inference or result. A cause must justify the stated consequence. En revanche does not simply mean any English however: it usually balances one aspect against another. Avoid stacking connectors whose roles conflict. Test the argument by removing the connector and explaining the logical relationship in plain English.

outcome: I can write and revise an argument that separates a source's position from my own.
explanation: An argument essay or report needs a clear question, organized evidence and a supported conclusion. In comprehension, identify the source's claim, supporting reasons and limits before judging it. Selon l'auteur (according to the author) marks attribution; pour ma part (for my part) signals your position. A report may prioritize findings and recommendations, while an essay develops a line of reasoning. Revision checks logical links, reliable attribution, paragraph purpose and whether the conclusion goes beyond the evidence.

feedback.rule: An argument essay or report needs a clear question, organized evidence and a supported conclusion.
